yt_description:
Ever wondered how to sort data with a little more flair? 🤔 Meet Cocktail Sort, also known as Bidirectional Bubble Sort! Watch as we visualize this quirky algorithm that goes both ways to find its perfect order. 🚀 Perfect for beginner coders and anyone who loves a good visual explanation.  We'll break down how it works, its pros and cons, and why it's more than just a fancy Bubble Sort.  Don't miss out on the fun! 🎉
